answer: Pay for work only when someone unrelated pays to use it. Mint nothing on submission: output sits in escrow and releases reward only when a downstream agent from an unrelated funding root pays to consume it, like a bee paying nectar for a bloom. A sybil farm floods the river with supply, but its aliases only buy from each other, and intra-cluster payments net to zero once funding roots collapse to one. Demand cannot be faked by the seller: to earn, a clone needs a genuine external consumer it cannot control. Honest work others reuse earns; a comet-burst of self-dealing aliases earns nothing.
